prompt.zh-TW: 小安看到綠茵運動用品資產負債表的股東權益區列著資本公積 {{money:vars.cs}}，說：「公司有這麼一大筆錢可以用。」哪一個回應最正確？
prompt.en: An sees capital surplus of {{money:vars.cs}} in the equity section of Greenfield Sports’ balance sheet and says: ‘So the company has this big pot of money to spend.’ Which response is the most accurate?

text.zh-TW: 資本公積只說明錢的來源；那筆錢早已變成各種資產，不是放著的現金
text.en: Capital surplus only shows where the money came from; that money has long since become various assets, not cash sitting around

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。股東權益區的每一列都是「錢從哪裡來」，不是「錢現在在哪裡」；要看現金，請看資產區的現金。
feedback.en: That is right. Every line in equity says where the money came from, not where it is now; for cash, look at the cash line among the assets.

text.zh-TW: 沒錯，這筆現金就放在公司的銀行帳戶裡，董事會隨時可以動用
text.en: Correct, this cash sits in the company’s bank account and the board can use it at any time

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道資本公積是股東投入的，這沒錯。但資產負債表右邊的數字是來源，左邊才是資產；資本公積對應的現金可能早就買了設備或存貨。
feedback.en: You know capital surplus came from shareholders, which is right. But the right-hand side of the balance sheet shows sources and the left shows assets; the cash behind the surplus may long ago have become equipment or inventory.

text.zh-TW: 這是公司歷年營業賺來、還沒分配給股東的盈餘
text.en: This is profit the company has earned from trading over the years and not yet distributed to shareholders

feedback.zh-TW: 你把它和另一個股東權益項目想在一起了。歷年賺來未分配的是未分配盈餘；資本公積來自股東投入，不是營業賺的。
feedback.en: You are thinking of a different equity item. Profit earned and not yet distributed is unappropriated retained earnings; capital surplus comes from shareholder contributions, not from trading.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_g7h8}}分清了「來源」與「現在的形態」。{{option:o_j9k1}}把股東權益當成現金；{{option:o_m2n3}}把資本公積和未分配盈餘搞混。
explanation.en: {{option:o_g7h8}} separates the source from its present form. {{option:o_j9k1}} treats equity as cash; {{option:o_m2n3}} confuses capital surplus with unappropriated retained earnings.
